description: Subset of Realistimo's geo list (realistimo_geo_db.csv): every city row, plus the neighbourhood rows of София, Пловдив, Варна, Бургас, Банско (where the CSV has any). Columns that are NULL in the CSV are left out. <internal_id> takes internal_id, never the CSV row id. Regenerate with src/portals/realistimo/download-geo.ts --subset.
